$comment: 每月依賴檢查用：已經看過、但這次不升的決定。deferredLatest 記下當時審視的版本，PyPI 一超過它就自動恢復提醒。

pytest.reason: maintainer test suite baseline; keeps minimum compatibility floor across python 3.10-3.14

pytest-asyncio.reason: maintainer test suite baseline; keeps minimum compatibility floor across python 3.10-3.14

httpx.reason: maintainer test suite baseline; keeps minimum compatibility floor

ruff.reason: maintainer linter baseline; bump tested separately from product changes

pydantic.reason: Retain upstream >=2.0 compatibility floor; defer raising the baseline until validation/schema behavior is checked across the Python 3.10-3.14 matrix.

jsonschema.reason: upstream runtime compatibility floor; tracking calesthio/OpenMontage baseline

python-dotenv.reason: upstream runtime compatibility floor; tracking calesthio/OpenMontage baseline

Pillow.reason: upstream runtime compatibility floor; tracking calesthio/OpenMontage baseline

numpy.reason: upstream runtime compatibility floor; tracking calesthio/OpenMontage baseline

requests.reason: upstream runtime compatibility floor; tracking calesthio/OpenMontage baseline

google-auth.reason: Retain upstream >=2.0 floor; service-account Google TTS and Vertex AI authentication has no credential-backed smoke in this review.

google-genai.reason: Retain upstream >=1.0.0 floor; Lyria, Veo and Gemini Omni provider calls need separately authorized live validation before adopting a newer baseline.

openai.reason: Retain upstream >=2.44.0 Videos API floor; offline mocks do not validate live TTS, image and video calls with the newer SDK baseline.

fastapi.reason: upstream runtime compatibility floor; tracking calesthio/OpenMontage baseline

uvicorn.reason: upstream runtime compatibility floor; tracking calesthio/OpenMontage baseline

watchfiles.reason: upstream runtime compatibility floor; tracking calesthio/OpenMontage baseline

torch.reason: Retain upstream GPU floor; latest PyPI versions alone do not establish a compatible torch/torchaudio/torchvision and Windows CUDA combination; GPU model inference is not validated in this review.

torchaudio.reason: Retain upstream GPU floor; audio extension and torch compatibility must be checked as a matched Windows/CUDA set with real inference, not independent latest versions.

torchvision.reason: Retain upstream GPU floor; defer adoption until matched torch/Windows CUDA and basicsr face_restore/upscale compatibility are validated; upstream PR #875 remains a documented re-review trigger.

websockets.reason: Retain upstream >=14.0 floor; defer baseline adoption until Eleven v4 Turbo and realtime transport behavior is checked on 17.4, beyond the prior 17.3 evidence.
